# A0

> A0 is a typed programming language for AI-written code, with revision-checked patches and compilation to native code, WebAssembly, C, JavaScript, Java, C#, Metal and SystemVerilog.

## Start here

- [Primer](https://a0lang.com/primer.txt): a compact language reference for model prompts.
- [Docs](https://a0lang.com/docs.txt): the reference as plain text (also at /docs/).
- [Full guide](https://a0lang.com/llms-full.txt): primer, docs, and the home page text in one file.
- [Benchmarks](https://a0lang.com/benchmarks): method, charts and losses (also at /benchmarks.txt); raw numbers in https://a0lang.com/results/exec-benchmark.json.
- [Source](https://github.com/Joe-Simo/a0): source code and release binaries.
- [License](https://a0lang.com/LICENSE.txt) and [copyright notice](https://a0lang.com/NOTICE.txt).

## Rules of the language, in one line each

(In the Example line, `/` stands for a newline.)

- A0: `fn NAME T... -> T`, lines `ID OP ARG...`, `ret ARG`, `end`. Types u32 bool, arrays u32x4, records (u32,bool). Params p0 p1... Args: earlier ID, pN, u32 literal, true, false. Ops exact mod 2^32.
- add sub mul and or xor (bool too) shl shr (count&31) div (b=0: 4294967295) rem (b=0: a) eq ne lt le gt ge (unsigned, -> bool) select c x y
- call F a... | fold F n s a... state=s; i<n: state=F(state,i,a...)
- arr e... | rec e... | get a i (i mod N) | set a i v | at r k | put r k v
- EDIT: reply bare edit lines, e.g. `c add a b` (replaces c or inserts before ret; `c add a b @ x` inserts after x), `-c`, `ret c`, `fn f ...` (adds/replaces a function), `-fn f`.
